info.description:
This course consists of 16 chapters in the section of the Introduction to Translation of the textbook [1]: in order to help students to review knowledge about fundamental grammatical points in English, such as sentence structures, articles, conjunctions, particles, and prepositions, etc., as well as provide students with practice in selecting translation methods between English and Vietnamese, and vice versa.

The structure of the course contents includes grammar explanation and exercises.

The course requires students to read reference books and improve their vocabulary and structures in order to apply them in translation tasks of sentences or short paragraphs.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand terminologies, and skills and translating skills, and necessary language to translate a sentence or a paragraph in English into Vietnamese, and vice versa; Apply the English knowledge and grammar in translating familiar texts
Use translating knowledge and skills in real life and future professions.

Have knowledge and translating skills of the two languages in order to evaluate translating tasks and evaluate translated texts of their own and others; develop a self-taught ability to improve language, skills and professional ethics.

Understand the importance of translating tasks in the linguistics field, in reality, and future professions; develop interests in the course and confidence in their knowledge and skills obtained from the course; have professional ethics in translating.

sessions.topic: Toward creative and flawless translation skills
